text: {"brief_summary":"Example Trading LLC (synthetic) has about 220 employees across a Dubai head office, an Abu Dhabi branch and a Jebel Ali warehouse. Leave is currently requested by email or paper, HR keeps balances in Excel, managers approve without seeing who else is away, and HR spends about two days a month reconciling balances before payroll. The customer wants employees to request annual, sick, unpaid and compassionate leave online, including from phones. Line managers should approve or reject requests with a view of the team calendar. HR should be able to see and correct all requests and balances. Balances should be calculated under UAE labour law and be visible to employees. Monthly reports for HR and finance should be ready before payroll. Warehouse staff work shifts and some have no company email account. The company uses Microsoft 365 with company sign-in. Payroll is a separate system and its vendor has not confirmed an API. The first version should be live within three months. The IT team is two people, the budget is limited, and both Arabic and English are used. Power Platform is a strong alternative because of the existing Microsoft 365 tenant. It may be the better choice if recurring subscription costs exceed the budget, provided the company accepts the effort and risk of building the UAE leave rules itself.
